snippet.title: MATCHO: PLAY DEMO NOW
snippet.description:
Play the MATCHO Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4265610/MATCHO_Demo/ 
More: https://playmatcho.com 

Step into Max’s first mission near Laguna Ik, Mexico. Investigate a mysterious signal, fight alien bugs, and experience MATCHO’s real-time Match-3 FPS combat: tag targets, build chains, execute combos. 

This demo is a full story mission from the main game: exploration, dialogue, puzzles, collectibles, traversal, and combat in one run. Most players finish DEMO in 40–60 minutes. 

MOVE. THINK. CONNECT EVERYTHING. Use double jump, wall run, jump pads, and a grappling hook to control the fight and solve environmental challenges. 

If you enjoyed the demo, wishlist MATCHO on Steam to stay up to date on development and launch updates.

Licensed music used for this trailer:
🎵  Revenge - Song by Matthias Förster

 #MATCHO #SteamDemo #IndieGame #FPS #ActionAdventure #PuzzleGame #SciFi #Gaming
